function total(){return cart.reduce((a,c)=>a+(Number(product(c.id)?.price)||0)*c.qty,0)}
function syncCounts(){ $$('[data-count]').forEach(e=>e.textContent=getQty());$('#floatTotal').textContent=money(total());$('#floatCart').classList.toggle('show',getQty()>0);$('#pixTotal').textContent=money(total()) }
function renderMenu(){const g=$('#menuGrid');g.innerHTML=catalog.map((p,i)=>`<article class="product"><div class="product-image ${/pinsa|bebidas/i.test(p.category)?'brand-image':''}"><img src="${safe(p.image||IMAGES.logo)}" alt="${safe(p.name)}" loading="lazy"><span class="product-stamp">${safe(p.badge||p.category)}</span><button class="edit-product" data-edit="${safe(p.id)}" aria-label="Editar ${safe(p.name)}" title="Editar produto">✎</button></div><div class="product-body"><div class="product-meta">${safe(p.category)}</div><h3>${safe(p.name)}</h3><p class="product-desc">${safe(p.description||'')}</p><div class="product-foot"><div class="product-price"><small>${p.price? 'PREÇO':''}</small>${p.price?money(p.price):'—'}</div><div class="buy-row"><div class="qty-mini"><button data-minus="${safe(p.id)}" aria-label="Diminuir quantidade">−</button><output id="q-${safe(p.id)}">1</output><button data-plus="${safe(p.id)}" aria-label="Aumentar quantidade">+</button></div><button class="add-btn" data-add="${safe(p.id)}" ${p.price?'':'disabled'}>${p.price?'ADICIONAR':'CONSULTE A EQUIPE'}</button></div></div></div></article>`).join('');syncCounts()}
function renderAdmin(){const box=$('#adminProducts');box.innerHTML=catalog.map(p=>`<div class="admin-product"><img src="${safe(p.image||IMAGES.logo)}" alt=""><div><strong>${safe(p.name)}</strong><small>${safe(p.category)} · ${p.price?money(p.price):'—'}</small></div><div><button data-edit="${safe(p.id)}">Editar</button><button data-delete="${safe(p.id)}" aria-label="Excluir ${safe(p.name)}">Excluir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<p>Sem produtos cadastrados.</p>'}
function normalizeCart(){cart=cart.filter(c=>product(c.id));cart.forEach(c=>c.qty=Math.max(1,Number(c.qty)||1));save()}
function renderCart(){normalizeCart();let box=$('#cartItems');box.innerHTML=cart.map(c=>{const p=product(c.id);return `<div class="cart-item"><img src="${safe(p.image||IMAGES.logo)}" alt=""><div><h4>${safe(p.name)}</h4><small>${money(p.price)} cada</small><div class="cart-qty"><button data-cartminus="${safe(c.id)}" aria-label="Diminuir">−</button><b>${c.qty}</b><button data-cartplus="${safe(c.id)}" aria-label="Aumentar">+</button></div></div><div class="cart-subtotal">${money((Number(p.price)||0)*c.qty)}<br><button class="remove-item" data-remove="${safe(c.id)}">Remover</button></div></div>`}).join('');$('#emptyCart').hidden=cart.length>0;$('#checkoutFields').hidden=cart.length===0;$('#checkoutBtn').disabled=cart.length===0;$('#checkoutBtn').textContent=cart.length?'Finalizar e enviar no WhatsApp':'Adicionar itens ao pedido';$('#totals').innerHTML=`<div><span>Quantidade total</span><b>${getQty()} item(ns)</b></div><div><span>Subtotal dos produtos</span><b>${money(total())}</b></div><div class="grand"><span>Total</span><span>${money(total())}</span></div>`;$('#pixTotal').textContent=money(total());syncCounts()}
function openCart(){closeAdmin();$('#drawer').classList.add('open');$('#overlay').classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('lock');renderCart();loadCustomer();$('#drawerTitle').focus?.()}
function closeCart(){ $('#drawer').classList.remove('open'); if(!$('#adminModal').classList.contains('open')){$('#overlay').classList.remove('open');document.body.classList.remove('lock')} }
function openAdmin(id){closeCart();$('#adminModal').classList.add('open');$('#overlay').classList.add('open');document.body.classList.add('lock');renderAdmin();if(id)editProduct(id);else resetProductForm()}
function closeAdmin(){ $('#adminModal').classList.remove('open');if(!$('#drawer').classList.contains('open')){$('#overlay').classList.remove('open');document.body.classList.remove('lock')} }
function editProduct(id){const p=product(id);if(!p)return;$('#productId').value=p.id;$('#pName').value=p.name;$('#pPrice').value=p.price??'';$('#pCategory').value=p.category;$('#pBadge').value=p.badge||'';$('#pDesc').value=p.description||'';$('#pImageUrl').value='';$('#pImageFile').value='';$('#imagePreview').src=p.image||IMAGES.logo;$('#formTitle').textContent='Editar produto'}
function resetProductForm(){$('#productForm').reset();$('#productId').value='';$('#imagePreview').src=IMAGES.logo;$('#formTitle').textContent='Novo produto'}
function loadCustomer(){ $$('[data-customer]').forEach(el=>{if(customer[el.id]!=null)el.value=customer[el.id]});if(customer.mode){const r=$(`input[name="mode"][value="${customer.mode}"]`);if(r)r.checked=true}$('#pixAgree').checked=false;toggleMode();}
function storeCustomer(){ $$('[data-customer]').forEach(el=>customer[el.id]=el.value);customer.mode=$('input[name="mode"]:checked')?.value||'retirada';save()}
function toggleMode(){const d=$('input[name="mode"]:checked')?.value==='delivery';$('#addressFields').hidden=!d;$('#pickupNote').hidden=d;['street','number','neighborhood'].forEach(id=>$('#'+id).required=d);storeCustomer()}
function phoneMask(v){let n=v.replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,11);if(n.length>10)return n.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{5})(\d{0,4}).*/,(_,a,b,c)=>`(${a}) ${b}${c?'-'+c:''}`);if(n.length>6)return n.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{4})(\d{0,4}).*/,(_,a,b,c)=>`(${a}) ${b}${c?'-'+c:''}`);if(n.length>2)return n.replace(/^(\d{2})(\d{0,5})/,(_,a,b)=>`(${a}) ${b}`);return n?`(${n}`:''}
function makeMessage(){const now=new Date(),protocol='MNK-'+now.toISOString().replace(/\D/g,'').slice(2,14);const mode=$('input[name="mode"]:checked').value;const list=cart.map((c,i)=>{const p=product(c.id);return `${i+1}. ${p.name} — ${c.qty} x ${money(p.price)} = ${money(p.price*c.qty)}`}).join('\n');let address='';if(mode==='delivery')address=`\nEndereço: ${$('#street').value}, ${$('#number').value} — ${$('#neighborhood').value}${$('#complement').value?' · '+$('#complement').value:''}`;return `*PEDIDO MENK’S BURGER*\nProtocolo: ${protocol}\nData/hora: ${now.toLocaleString('pt-BR')}\nModalidade: ${mode==='delivery'?'ENTREGA POR DELIVERY':'RETIRADA NO ESTABELECIMENTO'}\n\n*ITENS*\n${list}\n\n*VALOR TOTAL: ${money(total())}*\n\n*CLIENTE*\nNome: ${$('#customerName').value}\nWhatsApp: ${$('#customerPhone').value}\nE-mail: ${$('#customerEmail').value}${address}\nObservações: ${$('#orderNotes').value||'—'}\n\nPagamento via PIX. Estou ciente de que a liberação ocorre mediante envio e confirmação do comprovante no WhatsApp da casa.`}
function openWhatsApp(){storeCustomer();if(!cart.length){alert('Adicione itens com preço cadastrado antes de continuar.');return}if(!$('#customerName').value.trim()||$('#customerPhone').value.replace(/\D/g,'').length<10||!$('#customerEmail').validity.valid||!$('#customerEmail').value.trim()){alert('Confira nome, WhatsApp com DDD e e-mail.');return}if($('input[name="mode"]:checked').value==='delivery'&&['street','number','neighborhood'].some(id=>!$('#'+id).value.trim())){alert('Preencha rua/avenida, número e bairro para delivery.');return}if(!$('#pixAgree').checked){alert('Confirme a ciência do pagamento via PIX para continuar.');return}lastMessage=makeMessage();$('#previewText').textContent=lastMessage;$('#waPreview').classList.add('show');$('#checkoutBtn').textContent='Abrindo WhatsApp…';const url=`https://wa.me/${WA}?text=${encodeURIComponent(lastMessage)}`;window.open(url,'_blank','noopener');setTimeout(()=>$('#checkoutBtn').textContent='Enviar novamente pelo WhatsApp',600)}
function addToCart(id,qty=1){const p=product(id);if(!p||!p.price)return;const c=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);if(c)c.qty+=qty;else cart.push({id,qty});save();renderMenu();if($('#drawer').classList.contains('open'))renderCart();const btn=$(`[data-add="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`);if(btn){const old=btn.textContent;btn.textContent='ADICIONADO ✓';setTimeout(()=>{if(btn.isConnected)btn.textContent=old},950)}}
function changeCart(id,d){const c=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);if(c){c.qty+=d;if(c.qty<=0)cart=cart.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderCart();renderMenu()}}
$$('[data-cart]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',openCart));$('#floatCart').addEventListener('click',openCart);$$('[data-admin]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openAdmin()));$$('[data-close]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{closeCart();closeAdmin()}));$('#overlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{closeCart();closeAdmin()});
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.closest('[data-add]');if(a){addToCart(a.dataset.add,Number($('#q-'+CSS.escape(a.dataset.add))?.textContent)||1);return}const plus=e.target.closest('[data-plus]'),minus=e.target.closest('[data-minus]');if(plus||minus){const id=(plus||minus).dataset.plus||(plus||minus).dataset.minus;const el=$('#q-'+CSS.escape(id));el.textContent=Math.max(1,(Number(el.textContent)||1)+(plus?1:-1));return}const ed=e.target.closest('[data-edit]');if(ed){openAdmin(ed.dataset.edit);return}const cp=e.target.closest('[data-cartplus]'),cm=e.target.closest('[data-cartminus]'),rm=e.target.closest('[data-remove]');if(cp||cm){changeCart((cp||cm).dataset.cartplus||(cp||cm).dataset.cartminus,cp?1:-1);return}if(rm){cart=cart.filter(c=>c.id!==rm.dataset.remove);save();renderCart();renderMenu()}});
$$('[data-customer]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(el.id==='customerPhone')el.value=phoneMask(el.value);storeCustomer()}));$$('input[name="mode"]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change',toggleMode));$('#checkoutBtn').addEventListener('click',openWhatsApp);$('#copyOrder').addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(lastMessage);$('#copyOrder').textContent='Resumo copiado ✓'}catch{$('#copyOrder').textContent='Selecione e copie o resumo acima'}setTimeout(()=>$('#copyOrder').textContent='Copiar resumo do pedido',1600)});
$('#productForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const id=$('#productId').value||('prod-'+Date.now()),prev=product(id);const price=Number($('#pPrice').value);if(!(price>0)){alert('Informe um preço maior que zero.');return}const image=$('#imagePreview').dataset.fileImage||$('#pImageUrl').value.trim()||prev?.image||IMAGES.logo;const p={id,name:$('#pName').value.trim(),price,category:$('#pCategory').value,badge:$('#pBadge').value.trim(),description:$('#pDesc').value.trim(),image};if(prev)catalog=catalog.map(x=>x.id===id?p:x);else catalog.push(p);save();renderMenu();renderAdmin();renderCart();resetProductForm()});
$('#pImageFile').addEventListener('change',e=>{const f=e.target.files?.[0];if(!f)return;if(f.size>3*1024*1024){alert('Escolha uma imagem de até 3 MB.');e.target.value='';return}const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{$('#imagePreview').src=r.result;$('#imagePreview').dataset.fileImage=r.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)});$('#pImageUrl').addEventListener('input',()=>{if($('#pImageUrl').value)$('#imagePreview').src=$('#pImageUrl').value});$('#resetForm').addEventListener('click',resetProductForm);$('#restoreMenu').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(confirm('Restaurar os 9 produtos iniciais? Isso substitui o catálogo atual.')){catalog=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(SEED));cart=[];save();renderMenu();renderAdmin();renderCart();resetProductForm()}});
$('#adminProducts').addEventListener('click',e=>{const del=e.target.closest('[data-delete]');if(del){if(confirm('Excluir este produto do cardápio?')){catalog=catalog.filter(p=>p.id!==del.dataset.delete);cart=cart.filter(c=>c.id!==del.dataset.delete);save();renderMenu();renderAdmin();renderCart()}return}const edit=e.target.closest('[data-edit]');if(edit)editProduct(edit.dataset.edit)});
$('#hamb').addEventListener('click',()=>{const menu=$('#mobileMenu'),open=menu.classList.toggle('open');$('#hamb').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open))});$$('#mobileMenu a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#mobileMenu').classList.remove('open');$('#hamb').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}));window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>$('#header').classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>20),{passive:true});document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){closeCart();closeAdmin();$('#mobileMenu').classList.remove('open')}});
$('#year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();renderMenu();renderAdmin();renderCart();loadCustomer();
})();
</script>
</body></html>
